name: Mexica

rounds.endCondition: Period 1 and Period 2 each end with a scoring; the game ends after Period 2 scoring

categories.label: District founding points
categories.hint: Blue value for the founder; white value for each other player present in the district when founded (printed on the token).

categories.label: Period 1: founded districts (temples)
categories.hint: Temple levels summed per district: 1st yellow, 2nd blue, 3rd white value; ties all score that rank and skip lower ranks.

categories.label: Period 1: palace start bonus
categories.hint: 5 points if your Pilli Mexica stands on a starting space at the end of Period 1.

categories.label: Period 2: founded districts (temples)
categories.hint: Same as Period 1 for founded districts.

categories.label: Period 2: unfounded districts
categories.hint: Most temples scores the district's land size, 2nd about half, 3rd about a quarter.

categories.label: Period 2: palace start bonus
categories.hint: 5 points if your Pilli Mexica ends on a starting space.

categories.label: Unused action point tokens (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Token điểm hành động còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most unused action point tokens wins

notes: family: area-majority. NOT verified against the official rulebook (no official PDF reachable); based on Board Game Arena help and board-game-rules.com, which agree on structure. Open details: rounding for 2nd/3rd place on unfounded districts (BGA: half / quarter; other source: half rounded up, third half of second rounded up); exact timing of the palace bonus in Period 1 vs end of game; shared victory if still tied after action tokens is from one source only. District values are printed on tokens, so entered as totals.
